table.name: Fires
table.purpose: Wildland fire occurrence records for the United States (1992-2015), one row per fire incident. This matches the USFS Fire Occurrence / '1.88M Wildfires' dataset: Julian discovery and containment dates, fire size and size class, cause, ownership, and county-level geography for ~1.88M fires across 50 states plus DC and PR.

CONT_DATE.name: containment_date
CONT_DATE.description: Date the fire was contained, stored as a Julian date (days since Jan 1, 4713 BC; .5 = midnight/noon convention). Empty for ~47% of rows (fires with no recorded containment). Range 2448622.5-2457391.5 corresponds to ~1992-2015.

CONT_DOY.name: containment_day_of_year
CONT_DOY.description: Day of year (1-366) on which the fire was contained; empty when containment date is missing.

CONT_TIME.name: containment_time
CONT_TIME.description: Time of containment in 24-hour HHMM format (e.g. 0701, 1800). Empty for ~52% of rows.

COUNTY.name: county_fips_code
COUNTY.description: County FIPS code (3-digit, zero-padded) of the fire location; empty for ~36% of rows. Some rows appear to hold non-numeric values (e.g. '5', 'Lincoln', 'SUFFOLK'), suggesting mixed/uncleaned county identifiers.

DISCOVERY_DATE.name: discovery_date
DISCOVERY_DATE.description: Date the fire was discovered, as a Julian date (same convention as CONT_DATE). Always populated; range 2448622.5-2457387.5 (~1992-2015).

DISCOVERY_DOY.name: discovery_day_of_year
DISCOVERY_DOY.description: Day of year (1-366) on which the fire was discovered. Peak around DOY 185 (early July).

DISCOVERY_TIME.name: discovery_time
DISCOVERY_TIME.description: Time of discovery in 24-hour HHMM format (e.g. 1400, 0235). Empty for ~47% of rows.

FIPS_CODE.name: county_fips_code
FIPS_CODE.description: 3-digit county FIPS code within the state; empty for ~36% of rows. Pairs with STATE to form the full 5-digit county FIPS.

FIPS_NAME.name: county_name
FIPS_NAME.description: Name of the county (FIPS_NAME) matching FIPS_CODE; empty for ~36% of rows.

FIRE_SIZE.name: fire_size_acres
FIRE_SIZE.description: Final size of the fire in acres (median 1.0, max 606,945 acres). Matches the standard US wildfire size convention.

FIRE_SIZE_CLASS.name: fire_size_class
FIRE_SIZE_CLASS.description: Size class code A-G based on acreage: A = <=0.25 ac, B = 0.26-9.9, C = 10-99, D = 100-299, E = 300-999, F = 1000-4999, G = >=5000 acres. Distribution (B most common) is consistent with this standard NWCG scheme.

LATITUDE.name: latitude
LATITUDE.description: Latitude of the fire ignition point in decimal degrees (range 17.94-70.33, covering US states/territories including Alaska and Hawaii).

LONGITUDE.name: longitude
LONGITUDE.description: Longitude of the fire ignition point in decimal degrees (negative, range -178.8 to -65.3).

OWNER_CODE.name: owner_code
OWNER_CODE.description: Numeric code for the land ownership/owner of the fire location; pairs with OWNER_DESCR (e.g. 14 = MISSING/NOT SPECIFIED, 8 = PRIVATE, 5 = USFS, 2 = BIA, 13 = STATE OR PRIVATE).

OWNER_DESCR.name: owner_description
OWNER_DESCR.description: Text description of land ownership at the fire location (USFS, BIA, BLM, PRIVATE, COUNTY, etc.).

STATE.name: state_code
STATE.description: Two-letter USPS state/territory abbreviation where the fire occurred (52 values: 50 states + DC + PR).

STAT_CAUSE_CODE.name: cause_code
STAT_CAUSE_CODE.description: Numeric code (1-13) for the statistical cause of the fire; pairs with STAT_CAUSE_DESCR (1 = Lightning, 5 = Debris Burning, 7 = Arson, 9 = Miscellaneous, 13 = Missing/Undefined).

STAT_CAUSE_DESCR.name: cause_description
STAT_CAUSE_DESCR.description: Text description of the fire cause (Lightning, Debris Burning, Arson, Campfire, Fireworks, Children, etc.).
